title: AIR CONDITIONING-FRONT WIRING
summary: Air conditioning (C60) engine-compartment wiring: the A/C harness from the dash panel to the blower resistor, compressor relay (blower relay), water-valve vacuum switch and the compressor clutch, with its ground wire at the compressor. The harness and vacuum hose are held to the dash panel with clips and a strap; the relay and the switch are each held by a screw. Don't plug in the compressor connector until the system has been leak tested.
